new_roles.description:
**As part of its mission, Alphapointe provides preferential hiring to people with vision impairments (legally blind).**

Alphapointe is a non-profit agency whose mission is to empower people with vision loss to achieve their goals and aspirations. Alphapointe offers a great working environment that's both challenging and satisfying as well as an array of benefits including medical, dental, vision and life insurance, short and long term disability, PTO, paid holidays and flexible spending options as well as a generous 401(k).

**Job****Su****m****mary:**The Director of Quality Assurance position is responsible for establishing a corporate quality assurance system and team that promotes customer satisfaction and that positively impacts the financial performance of Alphapointe. Champion continuous improvement efforts and defect reduction initiatives to establish an effective Quality Management System (QMS) at Alphapointe Kansas City and New York plants.

 

**Essential****Functions:**

 

* Initiates and implements quality improvement activities as appropriate (e.g. Kaizen, Six Sigma) to raise the performance of the company’s product lines.
* Approaches processes with the customer’s purpose in mind.
* Educates and trains employees as to their impact in the quality management system.
* Develops, implements, manages and integrates a QMS for manufacturing plants.
* Serves as the primary quality control resource for problem identification, resolution, loss reporting and continuous improvement.
* Manages quality control personnel on a day-to-day basis.
* Supports concurrent engineering efforts by participating in design development projects representing quality assurance and the customer.
* Designs, implements and documents procedures for process control, process improvement, testing and inspection.
* Establishes and implements metrics (process capability, control charts, measurement quality) for monitoring system effectiveness and to enable managers to make sound product quality decisions.
* Performs root-cause analysis and other problem solving activities to identify effective corrective actions and process improvements.
* Establishes collection and analysis systems of statistical date to predict trends that will affect improvement of product quality.
* Analyze customers’ product specifications to establish efficient, cost-effective requirements for ease of manufacture and reproducibility.
* Develops quality planning methods for all product lines.
* Develops process certification standards and assist in process certification.
* Monitors vendor performance and establish criteria and rating system for critical vendors.
* Reviews customer purchase orders, contracts and change requests and ensure that the necessary criteria and provisions are included in quality and process plans.
* Interacts with customers to identify opportunities to improve quality and establish feedback with manufacturing and development personnel.
* Oversees calibration and testing programs.
* Reports to management on quality issues, trends and losses.
* Reviews suppliers purchase orders and establish supplier quality requirements.
* Participates in internal and external quality audits.
* Interfaces with supplier and customer quality representatives concerning problems with quality control and assure that effective corrective action is implemented.
* All other reasonable duties, as assigned.

 

**Additional****Functions:**

* Coordination of plant safety and health: sponsor training programs and initiatives that promote a safe and healthy work environment.

 

**Kno****w****ledge****and****S****k****ill****Requirement****s**:

* Bachelor’s degree with a preferred major in Industrial Engineering, or other Engineering disciplines or a related field.
* Command of Statistical Process Control Methods and ISO environments is desirable.
* Two years’ work experience managing a quality assurance department in a manufacturing setting.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 

**Wor****k****ing****Conditions**:

* Lifting of product containers from assembly line to inspection point.
* Manufacturing environment.
* In-office position

Alphapointe is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran

new_roles.title: VP of Operations
new_roles.description:
Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* At least eight years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, printing, converting, industrial production, or a related operational environment.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with responsibility for operational performance and measurable business results.
* Experience with custom manufacturing, technical products, labels, graphic overlays, membrane switches, or related industries preferred.
* Experience managing within ISO-certified or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information internally and externally across organizational levels.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills strongly preferred to support employee engagement, training, and operational communication.

### **MATHEMATICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to interpret budgets, labor and production data, costs, inventory reports, and operational performance trends.
* Ability to use data to evaluate priorities, identify causes of performance gaps, and assess improvement results.

### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to think and act strategically and tactically, manage competing priorities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternatives, and coordinate practical solutions across departments.

### **WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is performed in office and manufacturing settings, with exposure to moving production equipment when entering production areas.
* Follow applicable site safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
* Travel to customers, vendors, and JN White corporate as needed.

**Position Type and Compensation** 
This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position based in Watertown, Connecticut. The annual base salary range is $120,000–$150,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits** 
JN White offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premium costs shared between the employee and employer. A variety of ancillary insurance benefits are also available; employee contributions and employer contributions, where applicable, vary by coverage elected.

Additional benefits include paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and profit sharing. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, company policies, and governing plan documents. Profit sharing is subject to plan terms and is not guaranteed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity** 
JN White is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodations** 
JN White provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law. Applicants who need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources.

**Employment Disclaimer** 
This posting describes the general nature of the position and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract. Employment with JN White is at will, subject to applicable law. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

new_roles.description:
**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

***We are interested in every*** ***qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.***

FXI is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FXI via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of FXI. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by FXI as a result of the referral or through other means.

new_roles.title: VP, Manufacturing - Fresh Bakery
new_roles.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

**Required Education & Skills**

· Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or an Associate's degree with significant experience.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Prior experience as a Plant Manager, General Manager, Director of Site Operations, or comparable senior manufacturing leader

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

· Experience developing manufacturing network strategy, including capacity, asset utilization, capital investment, and long-term capability planning.

· Demonstrated experience developing senior manufacturing leaders and building succession and bench strength across multiple operations.

· Experience managing significant operating budgets, productivity commitments, capital investments, and/or P&L responsibility.

· Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work across Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, R&D, and People & Culture to deliver business outcomes.

· Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

This role requires regular work in manufacturing environments and a visible presence across bakery facilities, including walking, standing, climbing stairs, and accessing production, warehouse, and office areas. The incumbent must be able to wear required personal protective equipment and work a flexible schedule as business needs require.

**Travel**

This role requires **at least 75% travel** , primarily to Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing sites and Headquarters. Regular and sustained on-site presence is expected to provide visible leadership, build strong partnerships with Plant Managers and site leadership teams, understand operating conditions firsthand, and support execution of manufacturing priorities and transformation initiatives

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$221,500-$304,600

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

**The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.**

new_roles.description:
**Work Location** :

New York, New York, United States of America

**Hours:**

40

**Line of Business:**

TD Securities

**Pay Detail:**

$225,000 - $225,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

Conducts a range of comprehensive analysis and research on individual corporations, industries, financial markets and/or economic developments to support business needs and publish high quality research reports/presentations aligned to industries and various markets. Also provides critical insights and industry information to support advisory services.

 

**Depth & Scope:**

* Highly seasoned professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas
* Takes a lead role in modeling and interpretation of advanced insights within research reports
* Integrates knowledge of sub-function's overarching strategy in developing solutions across multiple functions or operations
* Interprets internal/external business challenges and the industry environment, recommends course of action and best practices to improve products, processes, or services
* Solves or may lead others to solve complex problems; leads efforts or partners with others to develop new solutions
* Uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify solutions
* Communicates difficult concepts; converts information to compelling business context and advice; influences and gains alignment across increasingly senior stakeholders
* Acts as a technical expert / lead integrating cross-functional knowledge, impacting the achievement of business objectives
* Work is guided by policies and industry standards/methods
Works autonomously as the lead and guide others within area of expertise 

 

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree
* Masters or PhD preferred
* CFA designation preferred for publishing analysts and associates
5+ years related experience 

 

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Works closely with the sales and trading group to develop new relationships, and with other analysts and associates to provide ongoing guidance
* Develops and maintains contacts and relationships in the community and with institutional clients
* Leads in the compilation and evaluation of multiple data inputs for:
 + Companies/industries and/or
 + Financial markets and economic analysis research reports (e.g., initiating coverage reports, thematic reports, quarterly reporting initiatives, and marketing packages)
* Publishes high quality, comprehensive analysis and research on industry sectors and companies and/or financial markets and economic development
* Develops business relationships and generates profits from producing and sharing regular research publications
Provides service to clients (internal and external) in the form of information, expertise, analysis, and opinions regarding market information, financial markets, economic outlook, and investment strategies 

 

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Keeps abreast of market data, economic information, and key industry developments, as well as internal policies and regulatory standards (as communicated by Compliance) at all times to assist in maximizing profitability through sound and well-informed decisions; develop and maintain contacts with market participants
* Demonstrates governance, control, and risk management behaviors in alignment with TD policies and practices
* Adheres to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area
* Ensures respective programs/policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities
* Consistently exercises discretion in managing correspondence, information, and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate
* Participates in cross-functional/enterprise initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk/provide guidance for complex situations
* Conducts internal and external research projects; support the development/delivery of presentations and communications to management or broader audience
* Conducts meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/policies/practices
* Monitors service, productivity, and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process/performance improvements where opportunities exist
* Actively manages relationships within and across various business lines, corporate, and/or control functions and ensures alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements
Maintains a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite 

 

**Employee/Team Accountabilities:**

* Participates fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation, and teamwork, and ensure timely communication of issues/points of interest
* Provides thought leadership and/or industry knowledge for own area of expertise and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit
* Keeps current on emerging trends/developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools, and techniques
* Participates in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team
* Keeps others informed and up to date about the status/progress of projects and/or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities
* Contributes to team development of skills and capabilities through mentorship of others, by sharing knowledge and experiences and leveraging best practices
* Leads, motivates, and develops relationships with internal and external business partners/stakeholders to develop productive working relationships
* Contributes to a fair, positive, and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce
Acts as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Never: 0%; Occasional: 1-33%; Frequent: 34-66%; Continuous: 67-100%

* Domestic Travel – Occasional
* International Travel – Never
* Performing sedentary work – Continuous
* Performing multiple tasks – Continuous
* Operating standard office equipment - Continuous
* Responding quickly to sounds – Occasional
* Sitting – Continuous
* Standing – Occasional
* Walking – Occasional
* Moving safely in confined spaces – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (under 25 lbs.) – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (over 25 lbs.) – Never
* Squatting – Occasional
* Bending – Occasional
* Kneeling – Never
* Crawling – Never
* Climbing – Never
* Reaching overhead – Never
* Reaching forward – Occasional
* Pushing – Never
* Pulling – Never
* Twisting – Never
* Concentrating for long periods of time – Continuous
* Applying common sense to deal with problems involving standardized situations – Continuous
* Reading, writing, and comprehending instructions – Continuous
Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing – Continuous 

 

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The listed or specified responsibilities & duties are considered essential functions for ADA purposes.

**Who We Are**

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

**Our Total Rewards Package** 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

**Additional Information:** 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
 
 
**Colleague Development**

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

**Training & Onboarding** 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
 
 
**Interview Process** 
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

**Accommodation**

TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com . Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

new_roles.title: Director of Millwork Production
new_roles.description:
About the Position

We are an established architectural woodwork and custom millwork company based in Coconut Creek, Florida, seeking an experienced Production Manager / Shop Foreman to lead the day-to-day operations of our millwork shop.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, and shop production.

You will be responsible for keeping production organized and moving—from approved drawings and materials through fabrication, assembly, quality control, and preparation for delivery and installation.

We are looking for someone who can lead people, organize workflow, maintain quality, solve production problems, and take ownership of the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily architectural millwork and cabinetry production
* Schedule and prioritize jobs based on project deadlines and installation requirements
* Assign work to shop employees and monitor production progress
* Read and interpret architectural drawings, shop drawings, elevations, details, and specifications
* Review drawings and materials before fabrication to identify missing information or potential production issues
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers regarding priorities, changes, field conditions, and project requirements
* Ensure materials, hardware, and components are available when required
* Oversee cutting, machining, fabrication, assembly, and preparation for delivery
* Maintain quality control throughout the production process
* Inspect completed work for dimensions, workmanship, drawings, specifications, and company standards
* Identify and resolve production problems quickly
* Coordinate with installation teams to ensure fabricated components are properly prepared for the field
* Track production schedules and communicate potential delays before they become critical
* Train, supervise, and hold shop personnel accountable for quality, productivity, and workmanship
* Maintain an organized, clean, and safe shop
* Improve shop workflow, organization, efficiency, and production processes
* Ensure completed millwork is properly labeled, protected, packaged, and ready for delivery
* Help maintain machinery, tools, equipment, and other shop resources
* Enforce company safety procedures and proper equipment use

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of relevant experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, or a closely related trade
* Previous experience as a Shop Foreman, Production Manager, Millwork Foreman, Lead Carpenter, or similar leadership position
* Strong understanding of architectural millwork and custom fabrication
* Ability to read and interpret architectural plans and shop drawings
* Strong knowledge of woodworking materials, hardware, fabrication methods, and construction techniques
* Experience supervising and directing shop or production employees
* Strong understanding of quality control and professional millwork craftsmanship
* Ability to schedule and prioritize multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with Project Managers, installers, vendors, and shop employees
* Ability to take ownership of shop operations and work independently
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to work directly on the shop floor when needed

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* CNC machinery and CNC-based production
* Cabinet manufacturing
* Architectural woodwork
* High-end commercial or residential millwork
* Laminates, veneers, solid wood, and specialty materials
* Millwork hardware and specialty components
* Finishing and coordination with finishing vendors
* Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD, or similar software
* Production scheduling and job tracking systems
* Commercial construction and field installation coordination

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can run the shop—not simply supervise it.

The right person will know what is in production, what needs to be produced next, where potential problems exist, and what needs to happen to keep projects on schedule.

You should be comfortable leading employees while remaining actively involved on the shop floor.

Success in this position means maintaining an organized, productive shop that consistently produces high-quality millwork on schedule while minimizing mistakes, rework, and delays.

Compensation & Opportunity

* $80,000–$120,000 per year, depending on experience
* Bonus eligible
* Full-time position
* Stable, established architectural millwork company
* Opportunity for growth and increased responsibility
* Significant responsibility for shop operations and production
* Work on high-quality custom architectural millwork projects throughout South Florida

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed.

Candidates with direct architectural millwork or custom cabinetry experience should clearly identify that experience on their resume, including previous shop leadership responsibilities and the types of products or projects they have managed.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
At NAES, you’ll find engaging and challenging career opportunities in the power generation, renewable energy and industrial construction industry. At every level of the company, we share a common goal: To instill confidence in our clients through our steadfast commitment to safety, integrity and quality of work.

NAES is the largest independent operator of power facilities in the industry, operating more than 190 power plants throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and the UK that span all technologies and provide over 50 GW of capacity. With the strength of 4000 people, our growing family of companies now addresses the entire life cycle of power generation and other industrial plants.

As the largest independent operator of power facilities in the industry, we’ve come to be viewed as an employer of choice. We strive to attract and retain employees by offering competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package (including retirement) and promotional opportunities.

**Opportunity Summary**

Reporting to a Vice President, Plant Operations, the Operations Director will manage a team of Plant Managers to direct/coordinate NAES support during all phases of plant operations, manage/direct Plant Managers on matters relating to NAES performance in all appropriate areas, policies, procedures, and standards, and ensure that all contractual requirements are met and the maximum value is achieved.

**Here's a look at some of the work you'll be performing:**

* Manage and give direction to all assigned plant personnel responsible for providing support to assigned projects (O&M, Support, or "Third Party" projects as appropriate)
* Provide direction and oversight to assigned Plant Managers on action to meet NAES policies, procedures, contractual requirements and standards
* Manage/oversee coordination with other headquarters departments and NAES subsidiaries to maximize financial returns, achieve optimum project and Division performance in all areas, resolve problems with both internal clients (Plant Managers) AND external clients (Owners/Asset Managers), develop proposals for new projects and support overall Company growth
* Provide strategic and operational leadership for a portfolio of wind and solar renewable energy facilities, ensuring safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective plant performance.
* Lead and support site management teams in achieving operational goals, including generation availability, O&M performance, budgeting, workforce development, environmental compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with customers, asset owners, utilities, contractors, and internal teams to maximize plant performance, manage operational risk, and ensure contractual and regulatory requirements are consistently met.
* Coordinate with and support Marketing and Business Development representatives to identify growth opportunities and execute an integrated approach to fulfill these opportunities. Support the development of proposals for new projects and growth initiatives.
* Manage/oversee maintenance of plant programs to both support and meet NAES performance standards. Ensure plant managers have access to the entire suite of NAES Energy Services resources.
* By continuing assessment and oversight, evaluate plant and project performance in all areas. Identify and implement appropriate actions and follow-up to ensure that the required standards are met.
* Provide periodic reports assessing performance of assigned projects and plants including an assessment of operational and financial performance
* Identify performance shortfalls in any area and recommend or initiate (as appropriate) applicable corrective actions
* Coordinate with Customers - both internal and external - to ensure satisfaction with the services provided
* Manage projects and resources to achieve the maximum client (internal/external) satisfaction
* In coordination with the other NAES subsidiaries, develop "Lessons Learned" "Best Practices" to achieve and maintain the highest level of performance in all areas
* Using all appropriate resources within NAES Energy Services, manage the continuing NAES assessment and evaluation programs. Coordinate with and provide information to all appropriate organizations to achieve continuing performance improvements.
* Based upon the specific situations relevant to the plants and Owners, identify actual and/or potential policy issues; recommend policy revisions as appropriate to NAES Senior Management and, when approved, implement the policies
* Keeping NAES Senior Management appropriately informed, manage customer relations for all assigned plants. Identify and define all support resource requirements, overseeing and coordinating with all applicable organizations. Provide senior day-to-day management of associated physical facilities and Owners.
* In coordination with the Senior Executives, provide management of associated resources and personnel, including Human Resources and Accounting representatives

**NAES Safe**

Safety is a core value of NAES and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to be mentally alert and work safely at all times. Additionally, employees are required to adhere to all safety warnings and posted safety signs whenever on company property. Furthermore, employees must follow all NAES safety rules and procedures. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each employee’s performance.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* The initial starting annual compensation will range from $201,600 to $231,900 based on experience and qualifications.

**Working Relationships**

The Operations Director will report to a Vice President, O&M Services.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

This role requires sitting/standing at a desk, using a computer workstation, and the ability to handle long periods of screen time and typing.

Must be available for business hours Monday through Friday. Work is performed on industrial sites when traveling, requiring protective clothing and equipment. Extended hours may be required as a function of meeting customer needs.

**Fitness for Duty**

All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes successful completion of a post-offer drug screen.

**Performance**

All employees have the responsibility to both the customer and their co-workers to do the job right the first time, and to ensure the business needs are being met. NAES evaluates performance throughout the year. Performance reviews are completed on an annual basis.

**Why you’re the perfect addition to our team (about you):** 
 
This position requires fundamental technical knowledge of power plant systems, operations and maintenance. We are seeking a candidate with exceptional levels of organizational, communication, operational and financial management, assessment, and scheduling skills with proven management skills in an equivalent-level management position.

* Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or related field is preferred
* Broad management experience working with renewable projects such as wind, solar and hydro is highly desirable
* A minimum of ten years’ experience in an industrial or power plant environment is necessary to include operations, maintenance, regulatory accountability and plant profit/loss responsibility
* At least three years of Senior Management experience in directing the operations of multiple power or industrial plants is preferred
* Management experience in leading multiple personnel carrying out varied activities and tasks in diverse disciplines required, including management of tasks involving human resources, budgeting, accounting, and marketing/business development. Must have demonstrable experience with commercial and contract administration responsibilities.
* Excellent analysis and writing capability required
* Must possess a valid motor vehicle operator's license at all times

*NAES is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. It is the practice of NAES to seek employees of the highest quality and to select individuals on the basis of merit and competence, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status or affiliation protected under USERRA, or any other basis of discrimination prohibited by applicable local, state and federal law.*

* 10 - 15 years: A minimum of ten years’ experience in an industrial or power plant environment, to include Operations, maintenance, regulatory accountability and plant profit/loss responsibility

Preferred

Preferred

* Leader: Inspires teammates to follow them

Preferred

Preferred

* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks

new_roles.title: Director, Contract Manufacturing--Remote
new_roles.description:
Empowering Physicians. Improving Lives.
 
 
Are you ready to join a team that is redefining the medical device industry?
 
 
AngioDynamics develops innovative medical technologies that empower physicians to deliver improved care and patient outcomes globally. We believe that people living with society’s most challenging diseases deserve trusted medical solutions that deliver high-quality care, wellness, and cures to live healthier, happier lives.
 
 
Invested in You
 
 
We believe world-class innovation starts with world-class people. In this role, you will be surrounded by top talent and equipped with in-depth training to maximize your potential and accelerate your career.
 
 
Total Wellness
 
 
AngioDynamics helps physicians deliver better care for their patients. We take the same approach with our own people. Our comprehensive benefits package supports your health and your loved ones, so you can do your best work.
 
 
Ready to make a lasting impact on patient care? Learn more about this role below.
 
 
JOB SUMMARY – To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
 
 
The Director of Contract Manufacturing is responsible for developing and executing the company's contract manufacturing strategy to ensure reliable supply, consistent product quality, cost competitiveness, and operational scalability. This role oversees the selection, qualification, development, and ongoing performance management of external manufacturing partners to support current business requirements and future growth.
 
Working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Research and Development, Finance, and Commercial teams, the Director ensures that contract manufacturing partners meet established standards for safety, quality, service, cost, compliance, and delivery.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong background in external manufacturing, supplier relationship management, manufacturing operations, sustaining engineering, and continuous improvement. This individual will build strong partnerships, mitigate supply chain risks, drive operational efficiencies, and establish a scalable contract manufacturing network aligned with the company's long-term business objectives.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
1. Contract Manufacturing Strategy
 

* Develop and implement the contract manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, production requirements, and growth plans.
* Evaluate and optimize the external manufacturing network, including capacity, capabilities, geographic footprint, cost structure, and risk exposure.
* Identify, assess, and qualify new contract manufacturers to support new products, increased demand, and business expansion.
* Lead make-versus-buy assessments and provide recommendations regarding outsourcing, insourcing, and manufacturing footprint optimization.
* Develop long-term manufacturing partner strategies to ensure flexibility, scalability, and business continuity.

2. Contract Manufacturer Relationship Management
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with contract manufacturing partners, serving as the primary executive-level point of contact.
* Negotiate manufacturing agreements, service-level expectations, pricing structures, capacity commitments, and performance objectives in collaboration with Procurement and Legal.
* Establish clear governance processes, business reviews, escalation protocols, and performance improvement plans.
* Drive accountability and transparency across external manufacturing partners.
* Resolve complex operational, commercial, and relationship issues to protect business performance and customer commitments.

3. Operational Performance and Supply Assurance
 

* Oversee contract manufacturer performance related to production planning, capacity utilization, on-time delivery, lead times, yield, and throughput.
* Ensure manufacturing partners maintain adequate capacity, materials availability, staffing, and production readiness to meet forecasted demand.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Planning teams to align demand forecasts, production schedules, inventory targets, and capacity plans.
* Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies for supply disruptions, quality issues, capacity constraints, and geopolitical or logistical challenges.
* Lead recovery plans when external manufacturing operations fail to meet required service or production targets.

4. Quality, Compliance, and Regulatory Oversight
 

* Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure contract manufacturers comply with applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure appropriate supplier qualification, audits, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), change control, and continuous compliance processes are in place.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring defects, deviations, customer complaints, and manufacturing nonconformances.
* Promote a culture of quality, product safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the contract manufacturing network.
* Ensure manufacturing changes, process validations, and product transfers are appropriately controlled and documented, creating standard work for each key process and CM transaction.

5. Financial Management and Cost Optimization
 

* Develop and manage the contract manufacturing budget, including conversion costs, tooling, capital expenditures, and other external manufacturing expenses.
* Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives through process improvements, yield enhancement, productivity gains, material optimization, and commercial negotiations.
* Analyze cost drivers and manufacturing economics to improve total cost of ownership without compromising quality or service.
* Establish financial performance metrics and monitor actual results against budgets and targets.
* Support annual operating plans, long-range financial planning, and business cases for new manufacturing partnerships or capacity investments.
* Manage consignment inventory program – insuring planning alignment to forecast requirements. Establish standard reporting requirements.

6. New Product Introduction and Manufacturing Transfers
 

* Partner with Research and Development, Engineering, Quality, and Commercial teams to transition new products from development into commercial production.
* Oversee manufacturing readiness, process scale-up, technical transfer, validation, and production ramp-up activities.
* Ensure contract manufacturers have the technical capabilities, equipment, processes, and resources necessary to meet product specifications and volume requirements.
* Manage timelines, risks, and cross-functional deliverables associated with product launches, manufacturing transfers, and commercialization initiatives.

7. Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 

* Establish and maintain a standardized contract manufacturer scorecard and key performance indicator (KPI) framework.
* Monitor performance against targets for quality, delivery, cost, service, productivity, and compliance.
* Lead regular operational reviews and executive business reviews with strategic manufacturing partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Benchmark partner performance and implement best practices across the manufacturing network.

8. Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Lead, develop, and mentor contract manufacturing, supplier management, or external operations personnel, as applicable.
* Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships to align manufacturing decisions with business needs.
* Communicate manufacturing performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
* May perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS –The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill or ability required.
 
 
Education and Experience
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, procurement, or external manufacturing.
* 5+ years of experience managing contract manufacturers, outsourced production, or strategic manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success developing manufacturing strategies, managing supplier performance, and improving operational and financial results.
* Experience negotiating manufacturing agreements and managing complex supplier relationships.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, product transfers, capacity expansions, or manufacturing scale-ups.
* Experience working in a multi-site, global, or complex manufacturing environment preferred.

Skills/Knowledge
 

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, capacity management, and supply chain operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and performance management.
* Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and cost reduction.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, supplier audits, risk management, and corrective action processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive results across organizational boundaries.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, supply chain planning tools, and data-driven performance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to travel to manufacturing partner locations as required.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to effectively communication both internally and externally.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance. instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
AngioDynamics does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters and/or vendors who are not expressly under current written contract.
 
 
Your ultimate salary may vary depending on your job-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
### **At Materion, everyone is included, respected and offered opportunity to grow.** ***Join us!***

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations, Premium Targets provides strategic and operational leadership for a complex, multi-site manufacturing organization with domestic and international operations. This leader is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer performance, talent development, capital execution, and continuous improvement. The individual in this role will lead Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams, including manufacturing facilities across multiple locations. As the organization’s senior operations safety leader, the Director sets clear expectations, models visible safety leadership, empowers employees to identify and address hazards, and holds leaders accountable for proactive risk reduction and continuous EHS improvement. Working across Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions, the Director translates business priorities into sustainable results, standardizes manufacturing and business processes, and delivers exceptional service to internal and external customers. The role also leads operations strategy and financial performance, including gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Operations Leadership and Execution**
=======================================

* Lead a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture in which every employee is empowered and expected to identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and take ownership of a safe and healthy workplace.
* Lead manufacturing operations across Buffalo, Wheatfield, Albuquerque, Limerick, and Brewster, with strong matrix partnerships supporting Alzenau and Taiwan.
* Own performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, and customer commitments; establish clear metrics, review performance routinely, and hold site leaders accountable for results.
* Set and execute the Premium Targets operations strategy, multi-year roadmap, and long-range capital and workforce plans.
* Ensure facilities consistently deliver high-quality products on time to internal business units and external customers.
* Partner with Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions to align priorities and improve end-to-end performance.
* Develop, coach, and hold operational leaders accountable for business results, team effectiveness, and talent growth.
* Strengthen communication, operating discipline, and knowledge sharing across all Premium Targets facilities.
* Provide clear, timely business updates and recommendations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence, Strategy, and Capital Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion EHS excellence by ensuring regulatory compliance, audit readiness, effective risk assessments, timely incident and near-miss investigation, corrective-action closure, and consistent use of leading and lagging safety indicators.
* Serve as executive sponsor for the Premium Targets Lean manufacturing transformation.
* Advance daily management, structured problem solving, kaizen, standard work, process improvement, and cost-reduction practices across sites.
* Partner with Lean resources and site leaders to implement improvements and sustain measurable gains.
* Lead major capital programs, equipment installations, expansions, and facility transitions in partnership with Engineering, corporate, business-unit, and capital teams.
* Ensure capital initiatives meet approved cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives while integrating safety into design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies that support production, maintenance, planning, EHS, technical capability, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Commercial teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Enable best-practice sharing and process standardization across manufacturing locations.
* Lead financial performance improvement, with a focus on gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in a manufacturing environment, including significant manufacturing operations people leadership responsibility with a demonstrated ability to develop leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated success leading safety and EHS performance, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, engineering, and capital projects.
* Ability to lead end-to-end processes and deliver results through cross-functional and matrixed teams.
* Ability to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Leadership experience in a multi-site or international manufacturing organization.
* Experience leading a Lean transformation or enterprise-wide operating system.
* Experience managing major capital programs, facility expansions, installations, or transitions.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and systems-oriented thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into executable operating plans.
* Strong influence, collaboration, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure alignment and resources across functions.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with team members, peers, customers, and senior leaders.
* Sound judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, reconcile differing viewpoints, and make timely decisions.
* Visible, values-based leadership grounded in safety, integrity, accountability, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated commitment to coaching, succession planning, and the growth of talent across all levels.

Pay Range:

$148,500.00 - $237,100.00

*Actual base salary offered varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.*

**The selection of the person to be hired for this position is contingent on the candidate having export compliance eligibility for access to U.S. controlled technology which comes under the licensing jurisdiction of the U.S. Department of State, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the U.S. Department of Commerce, Export Administration Regulations (EAR).**

**The candidate selected will have to qualify as either a U.S. citizen, a U.S. National, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a Person Admitted into the U.S. as an Asylee or Refugee., a National of a country that is not prohibited from having access to U.S. controlled technology (via a letter of assurance), or a Person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on Materion’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with Materion’s business requirements.**

**Materion Corporation and its subsidiaries (the “Company”) is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also the Company’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity and maintain employment statistics on applicants.**

**Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the Company. Please inform the Company’s personnel representative if you need assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.**

**Materion’s Veteran Employee Resource group supports veterans and promotes the benefits of hiring veterans in the workplace. We honor all those who have served and are a military friendly company. Veterans are encouraged to apply and military experience and skills are transferrable to Materion careers.**

new_roles.title: Senior Director - Manufacturing (West Coast & Central Regions)
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Sr Director Manufacturing is responsible for the strategic and operational leadership of multiple chemical manufacturing sites within the **West Coast and Mid-West region** of the US. This role ensures safe, efficient, and compliant operations while driving performance improvements across production, maintenance, EH&S, quality, and supply chain functions. The director will lead site leadership teams, align regional goals with corporate strategy, and foster a culture of operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Travel to the sites will be about 40-65%.**

*The base salary range for this position in as for the job description criteria as listed is $254,000 to $300,000 annually. Our salary ranges are determined by market data based on position and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salaries for that position. Where an individual's pay falls within the range is determined by factors including, but not limited to, location, job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*

*In some cases, compensation may fall outside of this range depending on factors, including a candidate's qualification, skills, competencies, experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Provide oversight and direction to site managers across multiple chemical plants.
* Ensure consistent execution of production plans, maintenance programs, and reliability strategies.
* Monitor and improve KPIs including safety, quality, throughput, cost (FMC & VMC), reliability and environmental performance.
* Lead regional operations reviews and performance benchmarking.

**Safety, Health & Environmental Compliance**

* Champion a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other regulatory bodies.
* Support implementation of Process Safety Management (PSM) and Responsible Care® initiatives.
* Drive incident prevention, emergency preparedness, and environmental stewardship.

**Strategic Planning & Execution**

Align regional operations with corporate goals and long-term strategic plans.

* Lead capital planning and investment prioritization across sites.
* Support new product introductions, technology upgrades, and capacity expansions.

**People Leadership & Development**

* Build and mentor high-performing site leadership teams.
* Promote talent development, succession planning, and workforce engagement.
* Foster collaboration across sites and functions.
* Champion of the Ecovyst SHINE values and Employee Engagement across the region.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) practices to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) as well as site / unit On Stream Time (OST)
* Drive standardization of best practices across sites.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action programs.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with supply chain, engineering, EH&S, finance, and commercial teams.
* Represent regional operations in executive forums and strategic initiatives.
* Engage with local communities, regulators, and external stakeholders as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Mechanical Engineering; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in chemical manufacturing operations.
* Proven track record of managing multiple sites or large-scale operations.
* Strong knowledge of chemical process technologies, EH&S regulations, and operational excellence frameworks.
* Experience with PSM, ISO standards, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and strategic thinking skills.
* Must be okay with travel
