new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Printing Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Work Location: Newington, CT. This is an in person role, not remote, not hybrid**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:30 am - 5:00 pm**

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and performance of the Data-Graphics manufacturing facility. This position directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, safety, maintenance, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Plant Manager ensures production commitments are met while maintaining high quality standards, maximizing operational efficiency, controlling costs, and fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and safety.

The Plant Manager provides strategic and hands-on leadership to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs), customer satisfaction goals, employee engagement objectives, and business growth initiatives.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**Operations Management**

* Direct and oversee all day-to-day plant operations, including production, scheduling, quality, safety, maintenance and receiving activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality standards, delivery commitments, and operational efficiency.
* Develop, monitor, and achieve plant performance metrics related to productivity, quality, waste reduction, safety, downtime, labor utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales, customer service, prepress, and production teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establish priorities and allocate resources to support production requirements and business objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed to improve productivity and profitability.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, and production personnel to maximize performance and engagement.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, professionalism, and employee development.
* Conduct performance evaluations, establish performance expectations, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations matters, recruitment, retention, performance management, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training and development opportunities to support operational excellence.

**Quality Management**

* Champion quality initiatives to ensure products consistently meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Investigate quality concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Monitor production processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and defect reduction.
* Work closely with client services and suppliers to address quality-related concerns and maintain strong business relationships.

**Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Promote and maintain a safe work environment through training, audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and support accident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is utilized and safety procedures are consistently followed.

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee preventive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives throughout the facility.
* Evaluate equipment, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve throughput, reduce spoilage, and optimize labor utilization.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operational expenses.
* Monitor labor costs, production costs, and capital expenditures to ensure financial targets are achieved.
* Participate in forecasting, strategic planning, and capital investment decisions affecting the facility.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Communicate operational results, goals, and key initiatives to leadership and employees.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance, production metrics, quality trends, safety performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Keep executive management informed of significant operational issues, risks, and opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of company objectives.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience overseeing production operations and employees.
* Printing, packaging, direct mail, graphic communications, or related manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.
* Experience managing budgets, KPIs, production planning, and quality systems.

**COMPETENCIES**

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership and team-building abilities
* Ability to motivate and develop employees at all levels
* Effective coaching, mentoring, and performance management skills
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities

**Operational Excellence**

* Knowledge of manufacturing operations and process improvement methodologies
* Understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles
* Experience utilizing production metrics and KPIs to drive results
* Strong project management and organizational skills

**Technical Knowledge**

* Knowledge of printing operations, lithographic printing, flexographic printing, finishing, and mailing operations preferred
* Understanding of quality management systems and root cause analysis techniques
* Knowledge of maintenance planning and equipment reliability principles

**Communication & Business Skills**

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong analytical and financial acumen
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook
* Ability to effectively manage customer, vendor, and employee relationships

new_roles.title: Sr. Plant Manager - Painesville, OH
new_roles.description:
**Location:** Painesville, OH

**Employment Type:** Exempt, Full-Time, Onsite

 
**Shape the Future with Us.**

At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.

 

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

The Sr. Plant Manager leads the Painesville manufacturing site and is accountable for safe, reliable, and effective performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, capital, asset reliability, and continuous improvement.

 

This role sets the site’s strategy, builds a culture of safety and accountability, develops organizational capability, and partners across functions to deliver operational and business priorities.

* Champion personal and process safety, environmental performance, regulatory compliance, operational discipline, and risk reduction.
* Set and execute the site strategy and annual operating plan across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, people, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Manufacturing, HSE&S, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Logistics, and other site functions using performance metrics and effective management systems.
* Strengthen process safety, mechanical integrity, asset reliability, preventive maintenance, and overall equipment effectiveness.
* Apply Lubrizol standards and operating systems, including ISO 9001 and RC14001, to reduce risk, standardize work, and improve performance.
* Manage operating and capital budgets, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.
* Drive productivity, cost, quality, automation, and continuous improvement while protecting safety, reliability, and customer service.
* Build an inclusive, accountable, and engaged organization through talent development, succession planning, workforce planning, and constructive employee relations.
* Maintain a visible site presence and communicate effectively with employees at all levels.
* Partner across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commercial, R&D, and support functions to meet business and customer needs and share best practices.

 

**Required Qualifications that Enable Your Success**

* Safety-first leader with demonstrated success building safety culture and improving performance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field; Chemical Engineering preferred.
* At least 10 years of chemical plant and/or manufacturing experience, including 5 years of progressive manufacturing leadership.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, process safety, risk management, environmental and safety regulations, and asset reliability.
* Proven ability to lead, influence, develop teams, and engage employees at all levels in a matrixed organization.
* Strong problem-solving, continuous improvement, financial, and business skills, including operating and capital budget management.
* Effective communication and relationship-building skills, with the agility to learn, adapt, lead change, and challenge the status quo.
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools and flexibility to work outside normal hours as needed.

 

**Preferred Qualifications that Drive You Forward**

* Advanced engineering degree or MBA.
* Leadership experience in a complex chemical manufacturing facility.
* Knowledge of SAP.
* Project/change management and Lean or Operational Excellence experience.

 

**Your Work Environment.**

At Lubrizol, we’re committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and empowering environment where you can do your best work—whether in a lab, on the production floor, or in a hybrid office setting. Depending on your role, your work environment may include:

 

* Standing, walking, or operating equipment for extended periods.
* Working in a lab or manufacturing setting with appropriate PPE provided.
* Use of computers and digital tools in an office or hybrid environment.
* Occasional lifting or movement of materials.
* Adherence to rigorous safety protocols and ergonomic standards.

 

We continuously invest in our facilities and technologies to ensure they support your well-being, productivity, and growth. If you require reasonable accommodation, we are committed to working with you to ensure an inclusive and accessible experience.

 

**Benefits that Empower You.**

* Competitive salary with performance-based bonus plans
* 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution
* Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Paid holidays, vacation, and parental leave
* Flexible work environment
* Learning and development opportunities
* Career and professional growth
* Inclusive culture and vibrant community engagement 
 Learn more at benefits.lubrizol.com!

 

**Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You.**

 

For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value.

 

Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future.

 

**We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.**

#LI-AM1

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Factory Engineering
new_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and propose the Factory Engineering team’s plans and objectives, and monitor their implementation in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles, and Key Engineering Activities outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities systems.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascade objectives to all leaders in alignment with factory objectives, and implement the strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Develop a detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering, including year-over-year improvements.
* Develop a detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Implement Maintenance Foundations and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) practices.
* Leverage corporate resources and ensure compliance with Nestlé Market standards.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) is required, preferably in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, or Process. Experience would be considered in lieu of a degree.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 10 years of related work experience is highly preferred with at least 3+ years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as: Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $160,000.00 to $185,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace. 
 
To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company preparing to launch AtzumiTM (dihydroergotamine (DHE) nasal powder), a novel therapeutic product approved in the US for the acute treatment of migraine. AtzumiTM incorporates proprietary advanced powder and device technology (SMART – Simple MucoAdhesive Release Technology™) and is designed to be easy-to-use, easy-to-carry and for quick self-administration.

**Position Summary:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced, strategic leader to serve as Head of Quality Assurance. This individual will lead quality strategy and quality management systems through launch and early commercialization in the US. This role will oversee GxP quality activities across manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, quality systems, and vendor management to ensure inspection readiness and ongoing compliance. Furthermore, the Head of Quality Assurance will provide quality leadership for commercial launch readiness, including batch disposition, product release processes, complaint handling, deviations, CAPAs, change control, and product quality reviews. This is a critical leadership role responsible for scaling the quality organization to support the commercialization of Atzumiä (Dihydroergotamine) nasal powder and ensuring the highest standards of safety and efficacy. The successful candidate develops and provides quality strategy, vision, and direction across the organization, implementing company-wide GxP policies and practices and providing input to executive management, with decisions carrying long-term impact on the company's compliance posture and market success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain a scalable quality management system (QMS) that evolves from clinical-stage to commercial-readiness, ensuring compliance with FDA, ICH, and global GxP standards.
* Anticipate factors that could influence the company's quality strategy and market position, providing strategic direction across functional areas to support long-term compliance and business success.
* Establish and oversee robust commercial quality processes, including final product release/disposition, supply chain security, and distribution quality.
* Provide quality oversight for GLP, GCP, and GMP vendors; lead vendor qualifications, perform audits, and manage quality agreements with contract manufacturing and research organizations.
* Lead the management of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and quality investigations, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of effective corrective actions.
* Proactively identify compliance risks and advise executive management on regulatory developments that impact company strategy.
* Apply persuasive, data-driven communication to influence executive decision-making on quality and regulatory strategy.
* Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of GxP SOPs, policies, and controlled documents across all functional areas.
* Establish and manage the company-wide GxP training program for employees and consultants to foster a corporate culture of quality and compliance.
* Oversee commercial quality systems, including product complaint handling, adverse event reporting coordination, and annual product quality reviews (APQR).
* Partner with executive leadership to cascade company-wide quality policies and practices, ensuring consistent adoption and alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead and develop the quality organization through subordinate managers and team members, overseeing the successful execution of company-wide quality initiatives.
* Proactively identify, assume, and execute additional responsibilities, initiatives, and special projects as business needs evolve.

**Minimum Requirements Education/Experience:**

* A Bachelor of Science degree in a life science discipline (biology, chemistry, etc.) is required; an advanced degree is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and articulate company-wide quality strategy, vision, and direction, with the ability to anticipate emerging risks and their impact on business success.
* 10+ years of industry experience in Quality Assurance within the pharmaceutical or biotech sectors, with at least 8 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading a quality function through a US commercial product launch and transitioning from clinical to commercial GxP requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US FDA GxP and ICH requirements; experience with European (EMA) or APAC regulations is highly desirable.
* Proven experience developing and implementing company-wide QMS platforms and managing complex quality investigations.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a "partnership approach" to working with cross-functional project teams and external partners.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (domestic and international) for vendor audits and site visits as required.
* Proven experience negotiating and influencing at the executive level, partnering with leadership to align quality strategy with organizational goals.

**Benefits and Pay:**

The expected salary range for this position is $230,000.00 - $270,000.00 USD. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing its employees with benefit options that are comprehensive, competitive, and that individual employees can tailor to their and their families’ specific needs. Eligible employees are offered Health Insurance, Dental & Vision Insurance, Healthcare & Dependent Care FSA, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401(k) Savings Plan, Long-term Incentive Plan, Life Insurance, Accident & Disability Insurance, Telemedicine, Generous Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays.

**EEO & Employment Eligibility:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We provide equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Satsuma Pharmaceuticals also complies with all applicable national, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification required of applicable law.

new_roles.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.
* Evidence of coaching and mentoring colleagues without relying on reporting authority, and the ability to deliver independently in a fast-moving environment.
Clear communication with customers, technical teams, and senior leaders, including an honest account of what is known, uncertain, or still unproven. 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Evaluation platforms, agent systems, AI observability, retrieval, or enterprise AI products.
* Building in an AI-native startup or entrepreneurial environment, taking a new product from early customer learning to adoption, and applying lessons from both successful and unsuccessful experiments.
* Hands-on prototyping with coding agents and delivery of customer-facing performance or outcome experiences.
Leading initiatives that require agreement across research, engineering, product, and customer-facing organizations. 

What success looks like
 
 
Customers see credible improvement in real agent workflows, supported by evaluations they can trust. You independently take an initial quality problem from failure analysis through experimentation and customer validation, and deliver a focused feature with engineering. Teams make better release and investment decisions because of the evidence, product judgment, and coaching you bring.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

The typical base salary range for this position is $218,400 - $365,200 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $263,200 - $401,400 annually.

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Retirement Plans
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Ops Excellence and Resiliency to build and lead the process improvement, operational resilience, and AI transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role will turn findings and opportunities identified through Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, incidents, and operational performance into redesigned workflows, stronger operating models, and scalable transformation roadmaps. The Senior Manager will bring a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify and standardize how work gets done, identify critical dependencies and failure points, strengthen contingency and readiness practices, and develop an AI transformation roadmap that rethinks how Risk Operations can operate—not simply make today’s manual steps faster. The role will partner across Risk Operations and with Product, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders to move validated opportunities from insight to sustainable operational change.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build the Ops Excellence and Resiliency capability for Risk Operations, creating an integrated approach to process improvement, operational resilience, and technology-enabled transformation.
* Translate findings from Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, root cause analysis, incidents, and operational performance into a prioritized portfolio of process, resilience, automation, and AI transformation opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign by applying a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify, standardize, and optimize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary manual work, inefficient handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* Build an operational resilience model by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs across Risk Operations.
* Develop dependency maps, contingency playbooks, and operational readiness practices in partnership with process owners to help critical incident and safety response capabilities continue through disruption.
* Develop and maintain the AI transformation roadmap for Risk Operations, identifying where AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, reporting, and other workflows rather than simply automate individual manual steps.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on operational value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment to business needs, and translate validated opportunities into pilots and delivery roadmaps with Product and Technology partners.
* Partner with Incident Management, Safety, Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to redesign workflows and implement sustainable improvements across organizational boundaries.
* Establish measures of success for transformation and resilience efforts, including cycle-time reduction, handoffs eliminated, process consistency, adoption, resilience readiness, recovery performance, and realized benefits from automation and AI-enabled changes.
* Create clear executive reporting and recommendations that show the improvement portfolio, resilience risks and readiness, AI transformation opportunities, implementation progress, dependencies, decisions required, and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in operational excellence, process engineering, continuous improvement, operational resilience, business continuity, technology transformation, program management, risk operations, or related fields.
* 3+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional initiatives in high-volume or operationally complex environments.
* Demonstrated experience redesigning and simplifying end-to-end operational processes, with the ability to translate findings and pain points into scalable future-state workflows.
* Strong process engineering and structured problem-solving capabilities, with experience identifying root causes, dependencies, failure points, and opportunities to reduce manual work and inefficient handoffs.
* Experience building or supporting operational resilience, business continuity, contingency planning, dependency mapping, or operational readiness programs.
* Experience developing and executing transformation roadmaps involving technology, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operations, including the ability to distinguish incremental automation from broader operating-model transformation.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills with the ability to synthesize monitoring findings, risk intelligence, operational metrics, and stakeholder input into prioritized improvement opportunities and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, program leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to partner across Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk Operations, and other cross-functional teams to move ideas from identification through implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in last-mile delivery, gig economy platforms, marketplaces, trust & safety, transportation, retail, e-commerce, investigations, fraud/risk operations, or other high-volume decision environments.
* Familiarity with TPM, Lean/Six Sigma, process engineering, systems thinking, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience designing business continuity or operational resilience frameworks, including dependency mapping, contingency playbooks, readiness exercises, or recovery planning.
* Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing AI and automation opportunities within complex operational workflows, including development of opportunity roadmaps, pilots, or business cases.
* Experience partnering with monitoring, assurance, risk intelligence, product, engineering, and analytics teams to convert operational findings and emerging risks into sustainable process and technology improvements.

new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R51414
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/14/2026

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
new_roles.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

new_roles.description:
**Role Description:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of all precast manufacturing operations to meet DVP business goals, while providing leadership to all plant and yard personnel.

**General Supervisory Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Create and manage production schedules based on manpower, customer demand, and DVP business goals
* Meet with General Manager as needed to review any safety concerns, production & quality issues, personnel needs, and inventory levels
* Conducts daily supervisor meetings to discuss production schedules, concerns, opportunities for improvement and to ensure ongoing organizational teamwork
* Hold monthly plant safety meetings and review any safety related deficiencies and submit recommendations to DVP senior management
* Track key performance metrics and hold direct reports accountable for results
* Ensure all production and yard operations meet DVP quality control standards
* Track and manage the inventory levels of finished goods
* Oversee and manage all incoming materials to ensure adequate inventory levels are met
* Continually collect and review data to reduce inefficiencies and waste
* Successfully hire, supervise, train, and retain production/yard staff
* Evaluate and review employee’s performance for the purpose of determining skill level and training needs
* Coach and mentor employees to allow for increased responsibilities and career advancement. Lead by example.
* Promote and maintain a clean work environment
* Recommend purchases of additional equipment for efficiency, cost reductions and/or quality improvements
* Successfully work with Quality Control/Project Management to meet customer demand and expectations
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Supervision of Plant Supervisors
* Leading by example, create and sustain a safe working environment for the facility

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Eligible to work in the U.S
* Successful experience in precast plant management
* Ability to read contract documents, engineering specifications and drawings
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Standing and walking for extended periods of time
* Exposure to fluctuating weather conditions including extreme cold or heat
* Must be in good physical and mental health

**Education and Experience:**

* 10+ years of precast concrete experience
* 5+ years production supervision or related experience

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Paid Time-off

Benefit Conditions:

* 60-Day waiting period

**Schedule:**

* Monday through Friday, minimum 45 hrs. Overtime & weekends may be required to meet project schedules.

**Pay Range:** Commensurate with experience
